readingPlan.title: Kingdom Companion | Integrated 365-Day Reading Journey
readingPlan.description: A one-year integrated journey through the entire Bible (all 1,189 chapters) woven together with the Kingdom Companion Discipleship Library (Volumes 1–3: Salvation & New Life, Spiritual Growth & Christian Living, Christian Character & Relationships), the Daily Devotional, and the Daily Encouragement — one reading, one reflection, one prayer, and one action step at a time. Days 1–60 walk through Volume 1; 61–210 Volume 2; 211–300 Volume 3; 301–365 bring it all together in integration.
